# Load data

```{r}
Datalogger_1 <- read_excel(
  "../Data/Zentra_Moisture_Sensors/z6-22118 07May26-1055_Blk1.xlsx",
  sheet = 1, skip = 2
)
Datalogger_2 <- read_excel(
  "../Data/Zentra_Moisture_Sensors/z6-24135 07May26-1104_Blk3.xlsx",
  sheet = 1, skip = 2
)

# Confirmed against raw file: Blk1 has 2 water-content columns (Port1, Port2)
# Blk3 sheet "Config 4" has 6 water-content columns (Ports 1-6), but Ports 3-6
# are all zero/inactive during the analysis window -- only Ports 1 & 2 are real.
Datalogger_1$Moisture_1 <- Datalogger_1$`m³/m³ Water Content...2`
Datalogger_1$Moisture_2 <- Datalogger_1$`m³/m³ Water Content...4`

Datalogger_2$Moisture_3 <- Datalogger_2$`m³/m³ Water Content...2`
Datalogger_2$Moisture_4 <- Datalogger_2$`m³/m³ Water Content...5`

# Sanity check before trusting the join: confirms 0 unmatched timestamps
# in whatever date range you filter to next.
range_start <- as.POSIXct("2025-06-20")
range_end   <- as.POSIXct("2025-07-04")

chk1 <- Datalogger_1$Timestamp[Datalogger_1$Timestamp >= range_start & Datalogger_1$Timestamp < range_end]
chk2 <- Datalogger_2$Timestamp[Datalogger_2$Timestamp >= range_start & Datalogger_2$Timestamp < range_end]
stopifnot(length(setdiff(chk1, chk2)) == 0, length(setdiff(chk2, chk1)) == 0)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(chk1), !anyDuplicated(chk2))

moisture <- full_join(
  select(Datalogger_1, Timestamp, Moisture_1, Moisture_2),
  select(Datalogger_2, Timestamp, Moisture_3, Moisture_4),
  by = "Timestamp"
)

moisture <- moisture %>%
  filter(Timestamp >= range_start & Timestamp < range_end)

```
# Reshape data into Tidy_data

```{r}

# Convert to long format
moisture_long <- moisture %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Moisture"),
    names_to = "Sensor",
    values_to = "Moisture"
  )

# Calculate mean and 90% CI 
moisture_summary <- moisture_long %>%
  group_by(Timestamp) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_moisture = mean(Moisture, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_moisture = sd(Moisture, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_moisture = sum(!is.na(Moisture)),
    se_moisture = sd_moisture / sqrt(n_moisture),
    ci90 = qt(0.95, df = n_moisture - 1) * se_moisture
  )

```

# Graph

```{r}
Moisture_graph <-
ggplot(moisture_summary,
       aes(x = Timestamp, y = mean_moisture)) +

  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_moisture - ci90,
                   ymax = mean_moisture + ci90),
              fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +

  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +

  # Drain start
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.POSIXct("2025-06-21 12:00:00", tz = "UTC"),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(x = as.POSIXct("2025-06-21 12:00:00", tz = "UTC"),
                y = 0.3,
                label = "Drain start"),
            angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5, color = "black", size = 7) +

  # Drain end (nudged a few hours right of the line so the label sits
  # clearly on the right side rather than centered on it)
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.POSIXct("2025-07-02 12:00:00", tz = "UTC"),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(x = as.POSIXct("2025-07-02 12:00:00", tz = "UTC") + 60*60*8,
                y = 0.3,
                label = "Drain end"),
            angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5, color = "black", size = 7) +

  scale_x_datetime(
    date_breaks = "1 day",
    date_labels = "%d %b"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.6),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.6, by = 0.1)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "(b) Soil volumetric water content during mid-season drain",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression("Volumetric water content (m"^3~" m"^-3~")")
  ) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 50, hjust = 1.2, vjust = 1.2),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )

Moisture_graph

ggsave(Moisture_graph, filename = "../Figures/Moisture_graph.jpg", height = 25, width = 30, units = "cm", dpi=400)


```
